programme.title: Kicking & Screaming
programme.desc:
After college graduation, Grover moves in with several friends and loses his girlfriend to a fellowship in Prague. Reluctant to step into adulthood, Grover and his friends wrestle with leaving the past behind.
Rated R

programme.title: W.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot

programme.title: What's New Pussycat?
programme.desc: Peter Sellers, Peter O'Toole and Woody Allen star in this wacky chapter from the swinging '60s where therapy becomes hilarity

programme.title: Topkapi

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution (1958)

programme.title: Sayonara

programme.title: A Shot in the Dark (1964)

programme.title: D.W. and the Beastly Birthday
programme.desc: Time to put on your party hats and dancing shoes – D.W. is turning five! When her birthday doesn’t go as planned, D.W. runs away to the magical island of Ukubonga. This is one party you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: The Rhythm and Roots of Arthur
programme.desc: Pack your bags, buckle your seatbelts, and get ready for an ARTHUR road trip to the family farm! Arthur’s Great-Grand Uncle Theo is celebrating his 85th birthday, so the Reads (and Buster) are off to Ohio to join in the festivities.

programme.title: Operation Christmas List
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Barney has a plan to get his dream Christmas bike: snag the season’s hottest toy, a Crabby Mousie Doll. But when a big-box CEO threatens his favorite toy store, Barney’s mission shifts to saving the shop—and maybe Christmas—first.

programme.title: Olympians at Heart
programme.desc: Twins Essie and Ella are best friends who share a passion for gymnastics. When they are both up for the same event, it causes a divide, and they're faced with the challenge of competing against each other.

programme.title: Mac and Me
programme.desc: A young boy confined to a wheelchair finds a lost alien creature and helps him return to his home and learn many magical things in the process.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie
programme.desc: Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie: Arnold and his class win a service trip to San Lorenzo. But when their trip takes a turn for the worst, their only hope of getting home may be retracing the dangerous path that led to Arnold’s parents’ disappearance.

programme.title: Bixler High Private Eye
programme.desc: Xander has a knack for solving mysteries and gets his biggest case yet when his dad goes missing. After his mom sends him to live with his grandfather in Bixler Valley, he finds a surprising lead in the case and builds an unexpected partnership.

programme.title: BLURT!
programme.desc: Nice guy Jeremy (Jace Norman) loses his ability to keep his thoughts to himself and can’t help but say everything out loud. The only way to fix his problem will be the hardest thing he’ll have to do: win the school election.

programme.title: Splitting Adam
programme.desc: After stumbling across a cloning machine, Adam Baker creates multiple versions of himself and finds the answer to handling his many summer responsibilities!

programme.title: Rufus
programme.desc: After Manny makes a wish on a magic amulet, his dog Rufus turns into a real boy, and the two rule the school.

programme.title: Rufus 2
programme.desc: Rufus crushes on a new girl at school with a secret. When Manny and Paige get suspicious of her, Rufus thinks they have it all wrong. Meanwhile, a mysterious villain seeks out the magic amulet.

programme.title: Ordinary Magic
programme.desc: After moving from India to Canada, 15-year-old Jeffrey (Ryan Reynolds) finds new purpose when a developer threatens his aunt’s home. Drawing on his roots, he rallies the community to fight back.

programme.title: 100 Things to do Before High School
programme.desc: With the pressures of high school in their near future, CJ and her two best friends decide to embark on a series of middle school adventures while they can still take risks and have fun.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: Awkward Jordan Sands, her annoying little brother, Hunter, and their dad were left Wolfsberg Manor in Romania by their mysterious great uncle. Once at the estate, a freak accident causes Jordan to slowly turn into a werewolf!

programme.title: Escape from Mr. Lemoncello’s Library
programme.desc: When twelve lucky kids win an invitation into legendary gamemaker Lemoncello’s extraordinary, high-tech library, they have no idea what’s in store. By navigating an elaborate scavenger hunt, they must compete to be the first to find their way out.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Vampire
programme.desc: When an introverted 17-year-old switches schools, the most popular girl mistakes him for a vampire. His supernatural persona helps him rule the school, but as word spreads, the truth becomes harder to hide!

programme.title: Monkey Up
programme.desc: A family comedy about a talking capuchin monkey seeking to gain fame and fortune as a movie star

programme.title: The Massively Mixed-Up Middle School Mystery
programme.desc: If it’s a middle school puzzle you need cracked, look no further than the sports shed where the Junior Eye Detective Agency’s got you covered. Everett, Alyssa, and Riley explore the ins and outs of their bizarre middle school.

programme.title: Chestnut
programme.desc: Young orphan sisters Sal and Rae think they’ve hit the jackpot when they find an adorable new Great Dane puppy on the same day they learn they’ve been adopted… Until they discover their new posh Manhattan apartment won’t allow dogs.

programme.title: Spymate
programme.desc: In this thrilling adventure, super-spy Minkey teams up with his retired partner, Mike, to rescue Mike's daughter Amelia, who’s been kidnapped. With her invention in danger, they must stop a world-threatening experiment in Japan.

programme.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programme.desc: Air Bud is back, this time playing baseball! Andrea and her friend Tammy join the team, but Andrea struggles with her new baby brother and fitting in. As Buddy helps on the field, they must also solve the mystery of disappearing puppies in their town

programme.title: Russell Madness
programme.desc: For Russell, a lovable terrier, family means everything and he'll do anything to find one to call his own – even get in the wrestling ring and take on the reigning champion!

programme.title: The Duke
programme.desc: When the faithful canine companion to the Duke of Dingwall, Hubert, inherits the Duke’s estate, he teams up with the Butler’s niece to fend off some greedy family members.

programme.title: Air Buddies
programme.desc: In Air Buddies, Buddy and Molly's five playful puppies—Mudbud, B-Dawg, Budderball, Buddha, and Rosebud—embark on a daring rescue mission when their parents are dognapped.

programme.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programme.desc: Josh and Buddy return in a hilarious adventure, taking on soccer while Buddy navigates fatherhood! With his new puppies and a state championship at stake, Buddy must balance family life and his role as a key player on the team

programme.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Andrea's summer plans are disrupted when her dog Buddy is dognapped by crooks targeting a priceless gem. With help from her new friend Connor and Buddy's skills, Andrea fights to win a volleyball championship and save Buddy.

programme.title: Pup Star
programme.desc: Welcome to a world where dogs can not only talk -- they can SING!

programme.title: Pup Star: Better 2Gether
programme.desc: In Pup Star: Better 2gether, Tiny, the Yorkie winner of a canine competition, faces a rival's trick and swaps lives with street pup Scrappy. Their journey through iconic cities teaches them about family, being true to oneself and who the real Pup Star is!

programme.title: MVP: Most Valuable Primate
programme.desc: Jack, a chimpanzee who recently escaped from an experimental lab, finds his way onto the ice at a junior hockey practice.

programme.title: MVP II: Most Vertical Primate
programme.desc: After being booted from his hockey team, Jack hits the road and meets Ben, a skateboarder with big dreams. Turns out Jack also has some impressive skater skills and the two set out on an hilarious cross-country skate tour!

programme.title: Jurassic School
programme.desc: Nerdy middle schooler Tommy takes care of a baby dinosaur after his cloned science fair project hatches early. When the dino escapes on fair day, Tommy must figure out a way to get the creature back before greedy grown-ups get to the dinosaur first.

programme.title: Princess and the Pony
programme.desc: A sheltered young princess is sent to live with relatives in America, where she befriends a pony held captive by a shady carnival owner.

programme.title: Pup Star: World Tour
programme.desc: Pup Star is back, and bigger than ever as the hit singing pup competition goes global!

programme.title: Jinxed
programme.desc: For generations, the Murphy family has been Jinxed with a 100-year old curse, if anything can go wrong it will go wrong. Meg Murphy sets out on a journey to break the curse and get the normal life she's always dreamed of living.

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: A stuffy businessman finds himself trapped inside the body of his family's cat.

programme.title: One Crazy Cruise
programme.desc: After being hypnotized on a cruise ship, a blended family of siblings wake up with no memory of what happened.

programme.title: Legends of the Hidden Temple
programme.desc: Three siblings embark on a temple tour and discover the legends behind it are real. They must navigate a series of booby-trapped rooms to lift the temple’s curse and escape with their lives.

programme.title: Best player
programme.desc: Quincy Johnson is a 30-year-old video gamer living with his parents. When they move he must win the cash prize at a gaming competition, face ‘Prodigy,’ a teen girl who’s also a sick gamer, & learn to not hide behind his avatar.

programme.title: Lost in the West Part 1
programme.desc: Stepbrothers Chip and Dave go back in time to 1885 and get entangled in a crazy Wild West adventure. Teaming up with two awesome local girls, they face off against the town's evil mayor and try to find a way back to the present.

programme.title: Lost in the West Part 2
programme.desc: Stepbrothers Chip and Dave go back in time to 1885 and get entangled in a crazy Wild West adventure. Teaming up with two awesome local girls, they face off against the town's evil mayor and try to find a way back to the present.

programme.title: Lost in the West Part 3
programme.desc: Chip is stranded in the Wild West and it's up to Dave to rescue his bro. With help from some unlikely allies, can they save the day once and for all and put the future right?

programme.title: Swindle
programme.desc: A team of six clever kids enact a daring plan to track down a swindler and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Big Time Movie
programme.desc: Big Time Movie: Big Time Rush is off to London on their first world tour, but as soon as they arrive they’re mixed up in a mission to save the world.

programme.title: Rags
programme.desc: Set against a New York City backdrop, this music-infused contemporary twist on the classic Cinderella tale stars Keke Palmer as international pop princess, Kadee Worth and Max Schneider as aspiring singer, Charlie Prince.

programme.title: The Electric Piper
programme.desc: Inspired by the classic story of the Pied Piper, this modern-day tale follows Mick, a 12-year old aspiring musician and Janis, his 10-year old sister. Together they embark on a magical rock 'n roll adventure.

programme.title: Turtles Forever
programme.desc: A battle between the Purple Dragons & what seems to be the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles is captured on film. The Turtles discover that their impostors are versions of them from another dimension.

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: Unlucky leprechaun, Happy McSweeney, is in for the adventure of a lifetime when he and his friends set out on a daring mission to retrieve the pot of gold that was stolen by the evil Houlihan from the McSweeney family years ago.

programme.title: CarGO
programme.desc: A young car learns the importance of family when he embarks on a mission to rescue his father – who’s been sent to Clunker Island to be repurposed as junk metal.

programme.title: Half-Shell Heroes: Blast to the Past
programme.desc: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles find themselves on the adventure of a lifetime when they accidentally time travel back to the Jurassic Era!

programme.title: Mo’gul Money, Mo Problems
programme.desc: Yuna knows how to stand out at her fashion school by making the most extravagant collection using the most luxurious of fabrics.When there’s a hiccup in her plan, she’s forced to innovate to truly impress the judges.

programme.title: Mogulize, and a Side of Fries
programme.desc: Proving to the school and her parents that she is meant for more than her family business, Winnie rises to the top of the Culinary Arts Branch using recipes drawn from her heritage.

programme.title: The Making of a Mogul
programme.desc: When her own business is discovered by a robot recruiter, Valeria Olivas is selected to attend Mogul Academy, a school for budding young entrepreneurs.

programme.title: Mogul on a Mission
programme.desc: At the Boss Ball, the culmination of everything the girls have worked for over the school year, each girl hopes she can win the coveted Mogie, a trophy honoring the best moguls.

programme.title: A Fairly Odd Summer
programme.desc: In the third live action movie based on The Fairly Oddparents series, Timmy Turner and his friends head to Hawaii!

programme.title: A Fairly Odd Movie: Grow Up, Timmy Turner!
programme.desc: Perpetual fifth-grader Timmy Turner, 23, has tried everything to stay a kid and keep his fairy Godparents. But will he grow up at last and save Dimmsdale, or will he stay a kid forever? Find out in A Fairly Odd Movie: Grow Up, Timmy Turner!

programme.title: JoJo Siwa: My World
programme.desc: Live from backstage, Jojo Siwa recounts all the events in her life that brought her to this - her biggest moment ever, a huge performance at the Mall of America and officially becoming a Nickelodeon Star!

programme.title: JoJo's Dream Birthday
programme.desc: JoJo is celebrating her birthday by living out her dream day! Join JoJo from the moment she wakes up, as she embarks on the most epic 24 hours of her life, filled with super special guests, big surprises, and a birthday party she’ll never forget!

programme.title: JoJo's Follow Your D.R.E.A.M
programme.desc: Follow JoJo as she embarks on her D.R.E.A.M. tour! Come along for the ride to get exclusive behind the scenes looks of JoJo’s rehearsals, life on a tour bus, and backstage at her shows.

programme.title: Albert
programme.desc: Albert: Albert, a little Douglas fir tree who loves Christmas more than anyone, goes on a road trip from his little nursery to the big city to make his dreams come true.

programme.title: Alone for Christmas
programme.desc: When a family visits Grandma's house on Christmas Eve, they leave their dog at home alone. And when burglars try to take the presents from under the tree, the dog must use every trick it knows to stop them.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: The Pup Star family just got bigger! the new pups: Cindy, Rosie, Charlie, and Brody will have to learn the true meaning of Christmas. Pup Star’s mean team, scheme to ruin Christmas, the pups end up in the North Pole to save Santa and the holiday spirit.

programme.title: Black Tide
programme.desc: Dany, the Arnault family’s teenage son has disappeared. The case is assigned to François Visconti (Vincent Cassel), a world-weary and disillusioned detective whose wife has just left him. The policeman investigates to find the missing teenager while he is reluctant to take care of his own son, Denis, 16, who seems to be mixed up in drug trafficking. When Mr. Bellaile (Romain Duris), Dany’s French tutor, learns about his former student’s disappearance, he offers his services to the detective.

programme.title: I Feel Better
programme.desc: A fifty-year-old man suffers from a sore back. All the world's doctors, radiologists, and oesteopaths can do nothing for him: the roots of his illness are pyschological. But what should he change about his work, his wife and his family in order to get better?

programme.title: We Have Forever
programme.desc: At the start of adulthood, Antoine has many options. The choice to work in his mom's restaurant or attend one of the top culinary arts school in the world. The choice to join his friends in Montreal or stay and chill in a small rural village and work as welder. The choice to believe Sara or to believe her younger sister Lea. Choices, detours and at times setbacks... but there is no need to worry when you're 20. Eternity lies ahead.

programme.title: Acide
programme.desc: During a heat wave, strange clouds start pouring down acid rain, wreaking devastation and panic throughout France. In a world teetering on the edge, a girl and her divorced parents must join forces to confront and try to escape this climate catastrophe.

programme.title: Dark Inclusion
programme.desc: Pier Ulmann (Niels Schneider) lives from hand-to-mouth in Paris, between construction work and petty theft that he commits on behalf of Rachid, his only “family.” But life catches up with him the day his father is found dead in the street after a long decline. The black sheep of a rich Antwerp family who deals in diamonds, he has left his son nothing, apart from the story of his banishment from the Ulmann family and a thirst for revenge. At his cousin Gabriel’s invitation, Pier goes to Antwerp to renovate the prestigious Ulmann family firm. Rachid ’s instructions are simple: “Go there at first to see; then to take.” But there are many facets to a diamond…

programme.title: Sweetheart
programme.desc: Heloise is a mother of three. Her youngest daughter, Jade, has just turned eighteen and will soon be leaving the nest to pursue her studies in Canada. As Jade's departure approaches, Heloise reminisces of their shared past, a tight bond between mother and daughter. Dreading this seperation, Heloise takes on the role of a filmmaker and attempts, with her iPhone in hand, to capture their last moments together. Her urgent desire to film these fleeting moments consumes her to such a point that it prevents her from reaching the complicity and happiness she has always managed to share with her daughter, her "baby".

programme.title: Django
programme.desc: 1943, occupied Paris. Django Reinhardt is at the pinnacle of his art. The brilliant and carefree jazz guitarist, king of ethereal swing, plays to standing-room-only crowds in the capital’s greatest venues. Meanwhile his gypsy brethren are being persecuted throughout Europe. His life takes a turn for the worse when the Nazi propaganda machine wants to send him on tour in Germany…

programme.title: Skies of Lebanon
programme.desc: Alba Rohrwacher plays Alice, a Swiss woman who moved to Beirut in the 1950s and falls in love with a Lebanese man. Wajdi Mouawad plays Joseph, an astrophysicist with dreams of sending his fellow citizens into space, and the object of Alice’s affection. Joseph and Alice appear to lead the perfect life until their bliss is ripped apart by the civil war and nothing will be the same again.

programme.title: One Nation, One King
programme.desc: Paris, 1789. The Bastille has been stormed and a breath of liberty blows through the streets of Paris. Françoise, a young washerwoman, and Basile, a drifter without a family or name, discover the unique exhilaration of love and revolution. Together with their friends and the people of the working-class districts of Paris, they begin to realize dreams of emancipation in a newly formed assembly where they witness, with both hopes and doubts, the creation of a new political system. Within their debates and the fury on the streets, lies the fate of their once sacred king and the birth of a republic._x000D_ Freedom has a story.

programme.title: The Double Lover
programme.desc: Chloé, a fragile young woman, falls in love with her psychoanalyst, Paul. A few months later she moves in with him, but soon discovers that her lover is concealing a part of his identity.

programme.title: Paris, je t'aime
programme.desc: This anthology explores the faces of love in a romantic Parisian setting. Directors include the Coen brothers, Alfonso Cuaron, Olivier Assayas, Wes Craven and more. Starring Juliette Binoche, Emily Mortimer, Steve Buscemi, Natalie Portman and more.

programme.title: The Umbrellas Of Cherbourg
programme.desc: A young woman separated from her lover by war faces a life-altering decision.

programme.title: The Piano Teacher
programme.desc: A young man romantically pursues his masochistic piano teacher.

programme.title: Young & Beautiful
programme.desc: After losing her virginity, Isabelle takes up a secret life as a call girl, meeting clients for hotel room trysts. Throughout, she remains curiously aloof, showing little interest. Subtitled.

programme.title: Le Samouraï
programme.desc: After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.

programme.title: The 400 Blows
programme.desc: A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

programme.title: Gun Runners
programme.desc: When it comes to world-class marathon runners, Kenyans are considered the cream of the crop. But some of Kenya’s top runners aren’t running for fame and fortune. Some are wanted warriors, running for their lives.

programme.title: Highrise - Universe Within - New York City - Hurricane
programme.desc: In the absence of timely government emergency response to the devastation of Hurricane Sandy, one woman turns to google docs to organize the relief efforts of volunteers going door-to-door, floor-by-floor in the highrises of south Brooklyn.

programme.title: I Am Skylar
programme.desc: Surrounded by a family and a community who show her unconditional love as she follows her personal path, Skylar faces the complexities of being a transgender girl on the cusp of puberty with refreshing honesty and unshakeable dignity.

programme.title: Snow Warrior
programme.desc: In the midst of an Edmonton deep-freeze, Mariah heads out. Every day, before dawn, while everyone else is sound asleep, she gets ready for her daily deliveries. Mariah is a bike courier, one of a handful of winter cycling snow warriors.

programme.title: The Memories of Angels
programme.desc: Like today's DJs who re-mix and energize contemporary music, Luc Bourdon has created a virtuoso mosaic of stockshots and clips from 120 NFB films to present Montreal of the '50s and '60s. A loving tribute to the vitality of Montreal.

programme.title: Unarmed Verses
programme.desc: This feature documentary presents a thoughtful and vivid portrait of a community facing imposed relocation. Unarmed Verses is a cinematic rendering of our universal need for self-expression and belonging.

programme.title: Way of the Hunter
programme.desc: Exploring one man’s evolving relationship with the natural world, Way of the Hunter tells the compelling story of Robert Moberg, a hunter who ultimately traded his gun for a camera.

programme.title: Place of Bones
programme.desc: On a remote ranch, a mother and her daughter fight for survival when a wounded outlaw seeking refuge brings a notorious bank robber and his ruthless gang, all desperate to reclaim a stolen fortune, right to their doorstep.

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

programme.title: The Ride Back
programme.desc: A lawman's grim duty and an outlaw's despair collide as Texas Marshal Hamish (William Conrad) must transport outlaw Kallen (Anthony Quinn) to face justice. But when Hamish is seriously wounded, which will Kallen choose: freedom or redemption?

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Huckleberry Finn (1974)
programme.desc: Jeff East is young Huck Finn in this song-filled adaptation of Mark Twain's popular novel that follows Huck and runaway slave Jim on an adventurous journey down the Mississippi River.

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

programme.title: Comes a Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: The Claim (2017)
programme.desc: THE CLAIM is an epic story of love, passion and redemption set against the winter landscape of the Sierra Nevada Mountains and the making of California. Dillon is a pioneer who defied the harsh winter in search of rumored gold.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: Another Man, Another Chance
programme.desc: Set in the late-1800s American West, a widowed frontier veterinarian and widow fall in love after losing their spouses.

programme.title: Adios, Sabata
programme.desc: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

programme.title: Sixgun
programme.desc: When three cowboys show up dead, Tommy, a retired bounty hunter whose ranch is on the brink for foreclosure, must saddle up one more time to stop the bandit and collect a ransom.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: Frank And Jesse
programme.desc: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: The cattle rancher McLintock (John Wayne) puts his brand on the territory and every woman in it! Louise Warren plays a widow who moves with her two children onto McLintock’s ranch to serve as cook, while Maureen O’Hara plays the estranged wife.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name (Clint Eastwood) receives offers from two gangs terrorizing a small town and accepts both, setting in motion a plan to destroy the criminals in a series of brilliantly orchestrated setups, showdowns, and deadly confrontations.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it’s an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders has killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Chato, a half-Apache horseman, is on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer, who is determined to see him dead. Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed, thanks to the unforgiving, cruel desert.

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin, and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: Loaded Pistols
programme.desc: Seeking a man who has killed his best friend in a poker game, Gene Autry finds a cowboy hiding from a posse. The young man's gun is the murder weapon yet Gene is convinced of his innocence.

programme.title: Mad Dog Morgan
programme.desc: The true story of Irish outlaw Daniel Morgan; who is wanted; dead or alive; in Australia during the 1850s.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: Starring Jack Nicholson ("Chinatown"), a cocky young cowboy sets out to track an experienced ex-bounty hunter who now has a price on his head.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs, and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this sumptuous, epic tale of the brave men and women in the U.S. who left the comfort and safety of life in the East for the promise of free land a better life in the untamed West.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army…and each other!

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Return Of A Man Called Horse
programme.desc: Richard Harris stars in this superior sequel which follows the plight of a horribly wronged tribe of Sioux Indians and the white man who would join in their revenge.

programme.title: Red River (1948)
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian 'Armored Bandit,' who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum portrays an Exterminator--in the American West. He will, for a price, eliminate any outlaws annoying the peace of any Western town. When his wife, in disgust, leaves him, he pursues her, only to encounter his greatest gunfighting challenge.

programme.title: Man of the West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Four theatrical families of the 1980s re-create the saga of the 1860s James Gang: Stacy and James Keach, David, Keith and Robert Carradine, Randy and Dennis Quaid and Christopher and Nicholas Guest.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as a host of stars, including Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick, have their eyes set on a shipment of whiskey and let loose in this wild comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun
programme.desc: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers (1959)
programme.desc: John Wayne, Constance Towers and William Holden star in this 1863, fact-based story about a Union mission to destroy a railroad junction deep within Confederate territory.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: In 1883, Geronimo and his small group of Apache warriors, under constant attack from both U.S. and Mexican military forces, reluctantly surrender in exchange for food and land. But promises are broken, and the Apaches declare all-out war on the U.S.

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow
programme.desc: Audie Murphy plays Matt, a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. When he inherits a massive ranch, it leads him back into the arms of an old flame (Terry Moore), as well as into the fists some old rivals who would rather see him dead.

programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: Burl Ives earned a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his portrayal of a family patriarch involved in a bitter land feud in this explosive western drama that also features a sumptuous musical score.

programme.title: Riders In The Sky
programme.desc: Gene Autry helps a gal clear her father's name who is accused of murdering a gambler. When the leader of the gamblers gets involved, it's up to Gene and his comic pal Pat Buttram to outwit the badmen.

programme.title: The Virginian
programme.desc: Molly Wood arrives in a small western town to be the new schoolmarm. The Virginian, foreman on a local ranch, takes a shine to her, and vows that he will make her love him.

programme.title: Angel And The Bad Man
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl.

programme.title: Oh, Susanna!
programme.desc: While riding to Mineral Springs Autry is robbed by thieves and then tossed off the train.

programme.title: Man from Music Mountain
programme.desc: When nasty land developers try to bilk honest ranchers who don't know their land holds lots of gold, Gene puts a stop to it.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: A special agent from Chicago is sent out west to bring in the notorious Reno brothers.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: In WW2 Burma, a Canadian bomber pilot becomes reckless after losing his bride in a Luftwaffe air-raid.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: When a sudden spurt of murders occurs in Texas Big Bend country, suspicion immediately falls on a young drifter who just moved to the area.

programme.title: Melody Trail
programme.desc: When a gypsy steals his rodeo prize money, Gene Autry and pal, Frog Millhouse, hire on as ranch cooks and Gene is soon attracted to the rancher's daughter, the mischievous Millicent.

programme.title: Mexicali Rose
programme.desc: Hired as a radio singer, singing cowboy Gene Autry soon discovers the show's sponsor is a crooked oil company cheating, among others, an orphanage on the Mexican border. With the aid of a music-loving bandit, Gene and Smiley Burnette ride to the rescue.

programme.title: Mountain Rhythm
programme.desc: Unscrupulous Pueblo Springs Valley resort owners wreak havoc for Frog’s Aunt Mathilda and neighboring ranchers in an effort to scare them off land recently placed for sale by the US Government.

programme.title: Mule Train
programme.desc: When natural cement is discovered by two prospectors, one is murdered during a claim jump attempt. Marshal Gene Autry befriends the lone prospector and tries to help him promote his cement discovery.

programme.title: Night Stage To Galveston
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Pat Buttram work for a newspaper publisher, and find evidence of corruption in the Texas State Police. The publisher’s daughter is kidnapped to prevent the story from being published.

programme.title: On Top Of Old Smoky
programme.desc: Gene Autry, who is mistaken for a Texas Ranger, helps the owner of a toll road, while she is being pressured by bad characters to relinquish her property, which contains valuable mica deposits.

programme.title: Pack Train
programme.desc: Gene Autry sets out to aid frontier settlers, threatened by a shortage of food and medicine. When storekeepers divert the supplies to gold miners, Gene and Smiley Burnette must ride to the rescue.

programme.title: Prairie Moon
programme.desc: When Deputy Sheriff Gene Autry agrees to become the guardian of a dying friend's three young sons from Chicago, he soon learns that the boys are a pack of ruffians and not the least bit impressed with cowboys and ranch life.

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, facing off a new type of criminal who has stolen the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes!

programme.title: Rancho Grande
programme.desc: The owner of a highly mortgaged ranch, where Gene Autry is the foreman, dies, and leaves the ranch to his madcap grandchildren. Gene must help them save the ranch and use the cash to build a dam.

programme.title: Red River Valley
programme.desc: Cowhand Gene Autry and his partner, Frog Millhouse, help Arizona cattlemen who are trying to build a dam that will bring water to their parched lands. Unscrupulous businessmen attempt to hinder these plans for their own profit.

programme.title: Rhythm Of The Saddle
programme.desc: Gene Autry is the ranch foreman for Maureen McClure and must protect her interests when rival ranchers and a gambler attempt to steal the rodeo franchise away from her Silver Saddle Ranch.

programme.title: Ride, Ranger, Ride
programme.desc: Former Texas Ranger Gene Autry receives a commission as lieutenant in the U.S. Cavalry and, along with troopers Frog Millhouse and Rufe Jones, reports to Colonel Summeral at Fort Adobe.

programme.title: Ride, Tenderfoot, Ride
programme.desc: Gene Autry inherits and runs a meat packing company. To get Gene to sell, the lady owner of a rival company starts a feud to derail Gene, who tries to recover by using rallies, parades, and bands.

programme.title: Riders Of The Whistling Pines
programme.desc: Gene Autry believes he has accidentally shot a man, but learns that the guilt lies with men trying to stop a destructive moth infestation. Will modern chemicals be used to save the day, against Gene?

programme.title: Rim Of The Canyon
programme.desc: Gene Autry, playing a dual role as his father and himself, is stranded by thieves who are searching for a stolen $30,000. A schoolteacher aids Gene with his search for the outlaws and the treasure.

programme.title: Ridin’ On A Rainbow
programme.desc: Gene Autry goes undercover as a showboat entertainer to search for and capture murderous bank robbers and recover the money. Gene befriends the young singer, Patsy, who is key to the investigation.

programme.title: Robin Hood Of Texas
programme.desc: Gene Autry and the Cass County Boys are unjustly arrested as bank bandits. Released by police as decoys to locate the loot, Gene and the boys find themselves in trouble with the real bank robbers.

programme.title: Rootin’ Tootin’ Rhythm
programme.desc: Ranch owner Gene Autry and his pal Frog Millhouse are after cattle rustlers and become mixed up in a comedy of errors when they don the clothes of two dead outlaws, only to learn that the outlaws are really dead sheriffs, dressed in outlaw's clothes!

programme.title: Rovin’ Tumbleweeds
programme.desc: Rancher Autry takes a job singing on the radio to aid farmers whose lands were destroyed by floods. Blaming crooked politicians, he goes to Washington and tries to put through a flood control bill.

programme.title: Saddle Pals
programme.desc: Gene Autry goes to the home of hypochondriac landowner, who gets Gene to switch identities while he takes a vacation, giving Gene power-of-attorney. Gene has to raise $50,000 to save the properties.

programme.title: Saginaw Trail
programme.desc: Gene Autry is sent to investigate the murders of settlers with the help of Smiley Burnette and two young homesteaders. Gene soon discovers that rich fur trader is behind the staged Indian raids.

programme.title: Shooting High
programme.desc: A Hollywood company arrives to film the story of Gene Autry’s grandfather, the town hero, and hires Gene to work on the film. When the star suddenly abandons the film, Gene steps in to save the day.

programme.title: Little Monsters
programme.desc: A washed-up musician teams up with a teacher and a kids show personality to protect young children from a sudden outbreak of zombies.

programme.title: Maggie
programme.desc: A teenage girl in the Midwest becomes infected by an outbreak of a disease that slowly turns the infected into cannibalistic zombies. During her transformation, her loving father stays by her side.

programme.title: Cell
programme.desc: John Cusack and Samuel L. Jackson star in this mind-blowing thriller based on the novel by Stephen King about a cell phone signal that triggers apocalyptic terror.

programme.title: Pride and Prejudice and Zombies
programme.desc: Five sisters in 19th century England must cope with the pressures to marry while protecting themselves from a growing population of zombies.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln vs. Zombies
programme.desc: While the Civil War rages on, President Abraham Lincoln must undertake an even more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.

programme.title: Anna and the Apocalypse
programme.desc: A zombie apocalypse threatens the Christmas cheer of the sleepy town of Little Haven, forcing Anna (Ella Hunt) and her friends to fight, slash and sing their way to survival.

programme.title: Black Friday
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving night, a group of disgruntled toy store employees led by store manager Jonathan and longtime employee Ken soon find themselves battling against hordes of holiday shoppers who have been turned into monstrous creatures.

programme.title: Seoul Station
programme.desc: In this animated prequel to the box office hit "Train to Busan," a group of survivors deals with a zombie pandemic that unleashes itself in downtown Seoul. Subtitled.

programme.title: Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: Months after a zombie plague has wiped out 90 percent of the American population, a small group of survivors fight their way cross-country to a rumored refuge on the island of Catalina.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Starring an ensemble cast of music’s biggest Pop Stars, a ragtag band of assassins team up to rid a small town of a zombie plague in the post-apocalyptic West.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Night Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira decides to clean out her basement, relaunch "Movie Macabre," and host "Night of the Living Dead."

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: I Eat Your Skin
programme.desc: While hosting "I Eat Your Skin," Elvira complains that there's no actual flesh eating in the film, so she invents the I Eat Your Skin Diet and hawks Zombatrim pills.

programme.title: Zoombies
programme.desc: When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

programme.title: Zoombies 2
programme.desc: A game ranger arresting poachers ends up saving their lives when a slew of zombie animals attack them in the jungle. Now surrounded by the creatures, the game ranger and poachers forge uneasy alliance as they work together to stop the beasts.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: A notorious religious satire, the film tells the story of Brian (Graham Chapman), a reluctant would-be messiah who rises to prominence as a result of a series of absurd and truly hilarious circumstances.

programme.title: Monty Python Live at the Hollywood Bowl
programme.desc: The legendary live show from the Monty Python troupe. Performing many of their greatest sketches from Monty Python's Flying Circus and two Monty Python specials, Monty Python's Fliegender Zirkus, live from the Hollywood Bowl in 1980.

programme.title: Monty Python Live (Mostly): One Down, Five To Go
programme.desc: Filmed on the final night of the run of ten sold out performances, live at London's O2 Arena, Monty Python Live (mostly) – One Down Five to Go sees the five surviving members together performing many of their classic sketches and much-loved songs.

programme.title: Monty Python Conquers America
programme.desc: This documentary, featuring new interviews with the Pythons and home-movie glimpses of fledging Python-mania, follows the troupe's long and winding road to the States, acknowledging the unsung heroes in the Python story.

programme.title: Monty Python: The Meaning of Live
programme.desc: This film captures the most anticipated comeback show in comedy history. It follows the stars of Monty Python as they reform and stage a marathon ten shows at The O2, London.

programme.title: Monty Python Live At Aspen
programme.desc: This reunion show features the five surviving members of Monty Python, with Graham Chapman in attendance in the form of his "ashes" being brought out in an urn. The Pythons look back at their work and receive an American Film Industry award.

programme.title: Monty Python: Before The Flying Circus
programme.desc: Before Monty Python, before the Flying Circus, before America, the Hollywood Bowl and the hordes of fans, there were just six young men who came together with an idea for a show – a show that would transform their lives and change comedy forever.

programme.title: Parrot Sketch Not Included: 20 Years Of Monty Python
programme.desc: Steve Martin presents selected sketches from "Monty Python's Flying Circus (1969)". It's the well known sketches, though the parrot sketch is not included. Steve Martin has some funny comments on the Pythons.

programme.title: The Meaning Of Monty Python
programme.desc: This programme celebrates the 30th Anniversary of Monty Python's final film The Meaning of Life.

programme.title: Eric Idle's What About Dick?
programme.desc: Only once in a lifetime there comes a cast like this Russell Brand, Billy Connolly, Tim Curry, Eric Idle, Eddie Izzard, Jane Leeves, Jim Piddock, Tracy Ullman and Sophie Winkleman - in a lowbrow comedy about highbrow people.

programme.title: Kickboxer III (The Art Of War)
programme.desc: David Sloan (Mitchell ) travels to Rio de Janeiro where the action is hotter, the women sexier, and the competition deadlier than ever before.

programme.title: SPITFIRE
programme.desc: A sultry assassin is the target of operatives from two international espionage agencies in this globe-trotting action flick shot on location in the Bahamas, Athens, Rome, and Hong Kong.

programme.title: The substitute
programme.desc: An ex-marine goes undercover as a substitute teacher and discovers a gang is terrorizing the high school. As lives are threatened, he sets out to clean up the crime-infested school.

programme.title: The Adventures of Hercules
programme.desc: The saga of the Olympian hero continues as Hercules valiantly strives to intervene in a war between the gods and save the world from certain doom.

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: Charles Bronson is Jay Killian, a secret service agent assigned the job of protecting the beautiful wife of the president.

programme.title: Brannigan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Chicago Police Lieutenant Jim Brannigan and Richard Attenborough co-stars as British policeman Cmdr. Swann in this action-comedy. Brannigan teams up in the U.K. with Cmdr Swann to escort a crime boss back to the U.S.

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Cutter's Way
programme.desc: This intriguing film features John Heard as a boozy, belligerent Vietnam vet who seeks passionate revenge on a murderer after his aimless friend (Jeff Bridges) is falsely accused of the crime.

programme.title: The Dogs of War
programme.desc: This riveting adaptation of Frederick Forsyth's bestseller stars Christopher Walken and Tom Berenger as mercenaries hired by a shadowy cartel to dethrone an African dictator.

programme.title: Harsh Times
programme.desc: An unstable Gulf War veteran with a savior complex receives a shocking wake-up call upon returning stateside and accepting a position with the Department of Homeland Security.

programme.title: Hero and the Terror
programme.desc: A murderer is determined to destroy Chuck Norris, the cop who had sent him away. Norris must find the homicidal beast before "The Terror" finds him.

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A lowlife drifter who sells used cars in a Texas burg robs the local bank and gets involved with two women: one bad, one innocent. Based on Charles Williams' 1952 novel "Hell Hath No Fury."

programme.title: Messenger Of Death
programme.desc: Could a feud between brothers lead to the massacre of an entire family? Charles Bronson travels to a Colorado to investigate and finds a plot of greed and religious zealotry. But can he solve the murders before he receives his own deadly message?

programme.title: No Man's Land (1987)
programme.desc: A Los Angeles rookie cop goes undercover to trap a wealthy young auto buff who operates a hot-car ring, and finds he likes his target, the target's sister and stealing Porsches.

programme.title: The Seven Magnificent Gladiators
programme.desc: Barbarians Lou Ferrigno and Sybil Denning fight alongside a daring group of gladiators to save a small village from the wicked Nicerote - half man, half god and completely evil – in an unforgettable collision of good and evil...and muscle and steel!

programme.title: Sinbad Of The Seven Seas
programme.desc: A dazzling adventure of faraway lands and heroic spectacles, this heart-soaring epic follows the brave Sinbad (Lou Ferrigno) in a rousing tale as he battles to defeat the evil wizard Jaffar (John Steiner), who has cast a spell upon a happy kingdom.

programme.title: Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1998)
programme.desc: When a subway train is hijacked, Det. Anthony Piscotti must outmaneuver the hijackers in a battle of wits that will end heroically or tragically.

programme.title: Full Contact
programme.desc: Two disreputable friends get tied in with a group of criminals who turn out to be excessively violent and deceptive.

programme.title: Force 10 From Navarone
programme.desc: A group of allied commandos on a mission against the 3rd Reich has orders to blow a giant dam in order to crush a strategic bridge held by the Nazis.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: Pam Grier stars as Coffy, a one-woman vigilante force, out to even the score with those who have hooked her sister on drugs. Coffy uses her sex appeal and an assortment of weapons to rid the streets of society's scum in this cult classic.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon (English Subtitles)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Highlander 2: The Quickening - The Renegade Version
programme.desc: Prepare to experience one of the most spectacular cinematic adventures...It’s 2024 and MacLeod (Christopher Lambert) and Ramirez (Sean Connery) are back to save planet Earth.

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: On an out of control train holding hostages and high-tech bio-weapons agent Kristoff (Van Damme) becomes a one man army to derail the terrorists and save the lives of everyone on board!

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a veteran cop and his new partner are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the barrios and slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: The Dirty Dozen: The Deadly Mission
programme.desc: The Dirty Dozen are back! Telly Savalas and Ernest Borgnine lead a motley crew of twelve renegade soldiers as they attempt to thwart a Nazi scheme of establishing a Fourth Reich in this thrilling -- and explosive -- World War II action-adventure!

programme.title: The Dirty Dozen: The Fatal Mission
programme.desc: Major Wright is threatened with court-martial unless he accepts an assignment to rescue six scientists coerced into developing a nerve gas so lethal that it could change the course of the war.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Fled (1996)
programme.desc: A witty and fast-paced Action Adventure, Fled tracks two prison escapes on the lam as they race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: Good Guys Wear Black
programme.desc: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Don Johnson and Mickey Rourke race onto the screen as two modern-day "Robin Hoods" in this futuristic adventure film that features high-speed motorcycles, daring stunts, and explosive action.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: James Caan and Robert Duvall star in Sam Peckinpah's tense, action-packed thriller that explores savagery and betrayal in the murky world of killers-for-hire.

programme.title: Lone Wolf McQuade
programme.desc: A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.

programme.title: Bridge of Dragons
programme.desc: The tough and cold mercenary Warchild (Dolf Lundgren, "Rocky IV") is working for the man who took care of his war training and upbringing the greedy General Ruechang.

programme.title: Malone
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds is Richard Malone, an ex-CIA agent looking to leave his past behind him and start a new life in the Pacific Northwest. But his dreams of living the quiet life soon goes up in smoke when he stumbles onto a military conspiracy.

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: A disturbing character study of a corrupt N.Y.C. cop's slide into insanity.

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an ex-con and Vietnam vet whose efforts to run a straight business soon have him locking horns with both the law and the mafia in this explosive tale of backwoods revenge.

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: Navy SEALs
programme.desc: When Middle-Eastern terrorists acquire some American stinger missiles, it's up to the U.S. Navy's elite commando unit, the Navy SEALs, to ward off their challenge and blow them up.

programme.title: Nine Lives (2004)
programme.desc: A former CIA agent suffers from extreme PTSD. While in a stress-reduction program, he is mistaken for an FBI agent and is thrust into action. With Wesley Snipes, Kim Coates.

programme.title: Operation Delta Force
programme.desc: When a San Francisco cop (Sam Elliot) is suspected of killing his partner, he begins to look for the actual killer. As evidence of the dead man's dirty dealings begins to mount, he discovers he didn't know his partner as well as he thought.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Go Tell the Spartans
programme.desc: A savvy U.S. major (Burt Lancaster) reluctantly obeys an ill-advised order to send out a unit of South Vietnamese troops and American advisors to a peaceful, former French outpost. He fears it will draw the Viet Cong into the area – and he’s right!

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: The Aggressor
programme.desc: David Sloan is on a mission to free his wife who has been enslaved by an evil world champion, Tong Po. He attempts to gain entry into Po’s savage kingdom by fighting in the tournament of champions where the winner takes all.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: The dangerous world of international heroin trafficking is exposed in this elaborate and suspenseful crime thriller which reprises Sidney Poitier's role as Lt. Virgil Tibbs.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle Leblanc, a man serving a life's sentence for killing his wife's murderer, must survive in a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment.

programme.title: Remo Williams: The Adventure Begins
programme.desc: A New York City cop is recruited by a super-secret, quasi-governmental agency which is out to avenge society's wrongs. The cop is trained for the job by a Korean Sinanju master, then cut loose on the bad guys of the world.

programme.title: Rolling Thunder
programme.desc: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann directs this stylishly photographed action-packed drama that stars James Caan as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman (Tuesday Weld).

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: Four teenagers develop paranormal powers after channeling a mystical stone found deep in the woods. They go from outcasts to gods on campus, but soon learn that absolute power corrupts...with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Double Blast
programme.desc: A master criminal/martial artist kidnaps a comely female professor, in hopes of translating a stolen ancient Utayo tablet and revealing its hidden secrets.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: When an international team of former Cold War intelligence adversaries meet in a Warehouse, their venture of friendship, intrigue and betrayal has just begun.

programme.title: Dogwatch
programme.desc: A team of military experts and scientists pursues a terrorist group who is threatening to release a deadly virus.

programme.title: F/X
programme.desc: Rollie Tyler, a movie special-effects man, accepts $30,000 from the Justice Department's Witness Relocation Program to stage the fake assassination of a mob figure who has agreed to name names.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: Chris Vaughn, a retired soldier who returns to his hometown only to discover the place he grew up is now overrun with crime, drugs and violence. Enlisting the help of his old pal, Chris gets elected Sheriff and fights to clean up his hometown.

programme.title: Death Wish 2
programme.desc: The vigilante strikes to avenge the killing of his daughter when five hoods break into his apartment, wreaking havoc. Death Wish 2 is a dramatic commentary on violent crime.

programme.title: Sweepers
programme.desc: In this action-packed thriller, a humanitarian minesweeping operation in Angola uncovers a covert organization that is planting new and deadly mines.

programme.title: Hard Cash
programme.desc: Released from prison, an infamous thief and his new crew pull off a brilliant robbery, but then become embroiled with a corrupt FBI agent when they discover the money is marked.

programme.title: The Way Of The Gun
programme.desc: A pair of bumbling criminals kidnap a woman for ransom money, but they soon realize they've made a huge mistake when they learn she is a surrogate for a ruthless mob boss.

programme.title: City Hunter
programme.desc: Extremely silly comedy about a self-indulgent private investigator who winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.

programme.title: Battle Royale
programme.desc: A group of students from a Japanese high school are forced to compete in a battle, killing one another until only one is left standing.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective teams with a police veteran to rescue a wealthy businessman from kidnappers.

programme.title: Legionnaire
programme.desc: Alain is a boxer in 1925 Marseille, France. When he doesn't take the dive paid to take by a mob boss, he has to split. He joins the Foreign Legion and is sent to Morocco. He makes 3 friends and they watch each other's backs.

programme.title: Dark Blue
programme.desc: When the LAPD's Special Investigations Squad is assigned a quadruple homicide, veteran detective Eldon Perry takes the case. Known for his street tactics and a temper, he tutors rookie Bobby Keough in the realities of police intimidation and corruption.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In a role that powered him to stardom, Charles Bronson is an underworld executioner who turns murder into an art form in this ultimate crime chiller.

programme.title: Robocop 2
programme.desc: This first sequel pits Robocop against a gang of drug dealers and the title creature--a supposedly improved version of himself that has gone berserk.

programme.title: Robocop 3
programme.desc: In this second sequel to the 1987 hit, RoboCop leaves the force and joins the rebellion to battle the evil business corporation OCP, which uses a police-like group to remove the homeless people who populate the site of a future upscale development.

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

programme.title: Death Wish 3
programme.desc: In this high-voltage thriller, Charles Bronson sets out to avenge the murder of an old friend who met his demise at the hands of a New York street hoodlum.

programme.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programme.desc: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancée (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

programme.title: The Evil That Men Do
programme.desc: A professional killer comes out of retirement to investigate and avenge the brutal murder of an old friend.

programme.title: Black Eagle
programme.desc: When one of the US Air Force’s most modern tactical aircraft crashes in the sea near Malta, the CIA dispatches their best agent to salvage the plane's advanced weapons system before it falls into enemy hands.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mysterious loner Eddie Lomax rides to the last outpost of an abandoned desert highway, prepared to end it all. But when a savage gang steals his prized cycle and leaves him for dead, Eddie's life is saved by a soulmate from his past.

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme is Lyon Gaultier, a deserter in the French Foreign Legion who travels to the USA and enters the gory world of bare-knuckled street fighting in order to make money to save his brother's life and family.

programme.title: The Order
programme.desc: Martial arts icon Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as a playboy criminal thrust into a dangerous world of ancient evil when he must investigate the disappearance of his archaeologist father. With Oscar winner Charlton Heston and Sofia Milos.

programme.title: Belly of the Beast
programme.desc: In this action-packed flick, a former CIA agent (Steven Seagal) goes to Thailand to rescue his daughter from the clutches of an Islamic terrorist group.

programme.title: A Private War
programme.desc: One of the most celebrated war correspondents of our time, Marie Colvin is an utterly fearless and rebellious spirit, driven to the frontline of conflicts across the globe to give voice to the voiceless.

programme.title: The Paperboy
programme.desc: A reporter returns to his Florida hometown to investigate a case involving a death row inmate.

programme.title: Welcome to Me
programme.desc: When Alice Klieg wins the Mega-Millions lottery, she immediately quits her psychiatric meds and buys her own talk show.

programme.title: A TALE OF LOVE AND DARKNESS
programme.desc: The story of Amos Oz's youth, set against the backdrop of the end of the British Mandate for Palestine and the early years of the State of Israel.

programme.title: Stories We Tell
programme.desc: Using a mix of interviews and sly home movies, Sarah Polley creates an intriguing profile of her family, especially her complicated late mother.

programme.title: Paterson
programme.desc: Jim Jarmusch's critically acclaimed film focuses on a working-class poet (Adam Driver) in a small New Jersey town who practices his craft amidst the quiet magic of everyday life.

programme.title: Sleeping With Other People
programme.desc: A good-natured womanizer and a serial cheater form a platonic relationship that helps reform them in ways, while a mutual attraction sets in.

programme.title: Support The Girls
programme.desc: The general manager at a road-side ''sports bar with curves" has her incurable optimism tested over the course of a long, strange day.

programme.title: Wiener-Dog
programme.desc: In this riotous comedy, an adorable dachshund puppy finds itself shuffled from one oddball owner to the next, including two couples, a veterinary nurse (Greta Gerwig), a screenwriter (Danny DeVito) and a cranky old woman (Ellen Burstyn).

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: After middle-aged filmmaker Josh and his wife Cornelia meet a free- spirited twenty-something couple, they adopt a new lifestyle. But with each hilarious attempt to act young, Josh and Cornelia start to appreciate the rewards of growing old together.

programme.title: Trespass Against Us
programme.desc: A man looks to find a way to escape the criminal ways of his outlaw family.

programme.title: Spring Breakers
programme.desc: Four college students are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them

programme.title: LADY MACBETH
programme.desc: In 19th-century rural England, a young bride who has been sold into marriage discovers an unstoppable desire within herself as she enters into an affair with a worker on her estate.

programme.title: LIFE ITSELF
programme.desc: The story is a multi-generational love story, weaving together a number of characters whose lives intersect over the course of decades from the streets of New York to the Spanish countryside and back.

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: When a debt puts a young man's life in danger, he turns to putting a hit out on his evil mother in order to collect the insurance.

programme.title: Laggies
programme.desc: In the throes of a quarter-life crisis, Megan panics when her boyfriend proposes. She takes an opportunity to escape for a week, hiding out in the house of her new 16-year-old friend Annika and her world-weary single dad.

programme.title: Mid90s
programme.desc: Written and directed by Jonah Hill, Mid90s follows Stevie, a thirteen-year-old in 90s-era LA who spends his summer navigating between his troubled home life and a group of new friends that he meets at a Motor Avenue skate shop.

programme.title: In Dubious Battle
programme.desc: Set in California apple country in the 1930s, nine hundred migratory workers rise up and join forces to protest unfair wages and working conditions.

programme.title: Janie Jones
programme.desc: A young girl who has been abandoned by her former-groupie mother informs a fading rock star that she is his daughter.

programme.title: Lovelace
programme.desc: Story of Linda Lovelace, who is used and abused by the porn industry at the behest of her coercive husband, before taking control of her life.

programme.title: JOE BELL
programme.desc: A small town, working class father embarks on a solo walk across the U.S. to crusade against bullying after his son was tormented in high school for being gay. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Intruders
programme.desc: Two children living in different countries are visited nightly by a faceless being who wants to take possession of them.

programme.title: THE DOUBLE
programme.desc: A clerk in a government agency finds his unenviable life takes a turn for the horrific with the arrival of a new co-worker who is both his exact physical double and his opposite - confident, charismatic and seductive with women.

programme.title: Green Room
programme.desc: A punk rock band is forced to fight for survival after witnessing a murder at a neo-Nazi skinhead bar.

programme.title: Friends With Kids
programme.desc: Two best friends decide to have a child together while keeping their relationship platonic, so they can avoid the toll kids can take on romantic relationships.

programme.title: GLORIA BELL
programme.desc: Gloria is a free-spirited, middle-aged divorcee who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor. After meeting Arnold on a night out, she suddenly finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance.

programme.title: Empire of Dirt
