programme.desc: Three generations of Canadian Aboriginal women find strength in family while confronting addiction and dysfunction in rural Ontario.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: A gripping true story of humanity and heroism, HOTEL MUMBAI vividly recounts the 2008 siege of the famed Taj Hotel. As the world watches on , a group of unlikely heroes will stop at nothing to keep the guests of the hotel safe.

programme.title: High Life
programme.desc: Monte and his daughter are the last survivors of a dangerous mission to deep space. The crew—death-row inmates led by a sinister doctor—has vanished. As the mystery of what happened onboard unravels, father and daughter must rely on each other to survive.

programme.title: First Reformed
programme.desc: A minister of a small congregation in upstate New York grapples with mounting despair brought on by tragedy, worldly concerns and a tormented past.

programme.title: Enemy Territory
programme.desc: Enemy Territory is the harrowing true story of a secular Jewish family in Iran as they fight for their lives immediately following the 1979 revolution.

programme.title: The End of Sex
programme.desc: A couple feeling the pressures of parenting and adulthood, send their kids to winter camp for the first time and embark on a series of sexual adventures to reinvigorate their relationship.

programme.title: Coriolanus
programme.desc: A banished hero of Rome allies with a sworn enemy to take his revenge on the city.

programme.title: 99 Homes
programme.desc: A man (Andrew Garfield) struggles to get back his family home that they were evicted from by working for the greedy real estate broker (Michael Shannon) who's the source of his frustration.

programme.title: A Most Violent Year
programme.desc: A MOST VIOLENT YEAR follows Abel (Oscar Isaac) and his wife (Jessica Chastain) during a crucial moment of their lives as they attempt to pursue the American Dream, while rampant violence, decay, and corruption threaten to destroy their burgeoning empire.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.

programme.title: Black Conflux
programme.desc: The seemingly separate lives of an anxious, disillusioned teen girl and a troubled, alienated man converge fatefully in this haunting exploration of womanhood, isolation, and toxic masculinity, set in 198 s Newfoundland.

programme.title: The Disappearance Of Eleanor Rigby
programme.desc: Jessica Chastain and James McAvoy dazzle in this drama hailed as "one of the most romantic love stories ever." A married couple torn apart by tragedy tries to reclaim the life they once shared.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: James (Hayden Christensen) owes his life to his older brother Frankie (Adrien Brody) after Frankie took the rap for a crime they both committed. After Frankie serves his time, he convinces James to join him in an ill-fated bank robbery in the hopes that one last job will change both their lives.

programme.title: The Bad Batch
programme.desc: THE BAD BATCH follows Arlen (Suki Waterhouse) after she's left in a Texas wasteland fenced off from civilization. While trying to navigate the unforgiving landscape, Arlen is captured by a savage band of cannibals led by the mysterious Miami Man (Jason Momoa). With her life on the line, she makes her way to The Dream (Keanu Reeves).

programme.title: The Burnt Orange Heresy
programme.desc: An ambitious art dealer is hired by an enigmatic collector to steal a rare work from one of the most reclusive painters in the world, in Giuseppe Capotondi's (The Double Hour) thriller based on Charles Willeford's noir novel. Starring Elizabeth Debicki, Donald Sutherland, Claes Bang, and Mick Jagger.

programme.title: The Climb
programme.desc: A comedic look at the roller-coaster relationship between two very unlikely friends that spans over many years.

programme.title: Colonia
programme.desc: A young woman (Emma Watson) embarks on a desperate journey to rescue her boyfriend from a mysterious and dangerous cult.

programme.title: Lions for Lambs
programme.desc: Lions For Lambs tells the poignant and layered story of several individuals caught up at various ends of the U.S. War on terror.

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: Mason Skiles, a former U.S. diplomat, gets sent to Beirut to negotiate a swap for the release of a terrorist leader, believed to be imprisoned by Israeli secret police, in exchange for a CIA agent who has been kidnapped.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: When Rodney Baze mysteriously disappears and law enforcement doesn't follow through fast enough, his older brother Russell takes matters into his own hands to find justice.

programme.title: Last Knights
programme.desc: A fallen warrior rises against a corrupt and sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonoured master.

programme.title: Home of The Brave
programme.desc: The story of four American soldiers nearing the end of their tours of duty in Iraq sent on one final humanitarian mission to bring medical supplies to a remote Iraqi village, but the unit is ambushed and takes heavy losses.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: A father (John Cusack) and his son attempt to bring in an assassin (Morgan Freeman) to the authorities, but his dangerous associates have other plans.

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Steven, a charismatic surgeon, is forced to make an unthinkable sacrifice after his life starts to fall apart, when the behavior of a teenage boy he has taken under his wing turns sinister.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: In this triple Oscar-winning film, a young drummer (Miles Teller) in his school's top-tier jazz band clashes with the intense, abusive methods of an obsessive music teacher (J.K. Simmons). With Melissa Benoist.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: Anthony Quinn and Anthony Franciosa portray New York cops in this fierce thriller about a deadly robbery investigation on the mean streets of Harlem.

programme.title: All Nighter
programme.desc: A workaholic father who attempts to visit his daughter during a layover in LA, only to discover that she's disappeared, is forced to team up with her awkward ex-boyfriend to find her over the course of one transformative night.

programme.title: Avenging Angelo
programme.desc: A woman discovers she is the daughter of a murdered Mafia chieftain and seeks revenge with the aid of her father's faithful bodyguard (Academy Award-nominee Sylvester Stallone, “Rocky”).

programme.title: Rob the Mob
programme.desc: A Queens couple who specialize in robbing mafia social clubs stumble upon a score bigger than they could ever imagine, becoming targets of both the mob and the FBI in the process.

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: Two childhood friends plan to rob an armored car depository, but experience a tough-as-nails NYPD officer (Dwayne Johnson) that stands in their way.

programme.title: State of Grace
programme.desc: In this neo-noir crime film, an undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in New York City's Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia, which is now led by two of his childhood friends (Gary Oldman and Ed Harris).

programme.title: The Meddler
programme.desc: After the death of her husband, a woman (Oscar winner Susan Sarandon) moves from New Jersey to Los Angeles to be closer to her daughter (Rose Byrne).

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: A New York City money launderer desperately searches for answers after waking up with no memory, millions in stolen cash and drugs, and an insane crew of dirty cops hunting him down.

programme.title: Autumn In New York
programme.desc: Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

programme.title: Ernest Goes to School
programme.desc: Jim Varney's recurring dim-bulb character Ernest P. Worrell returns in this film as a school maintenance man seeking to obtain a high school diploma.

programme.title: Uptown Girls
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Charlie Bartlett
programme.desc: Wealthy teenager Charlie Bartlett (Anton Yelchin) is failing miserably at fitting in at a new public high school run by the world-weary Principal Gardner (Robert Downey, Jr.).

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: When Valley Girl Julie (Deborah Foreman) dumps her preppy boyfriend, she unexpectedly finds love with rocker Randy (Nicolas Cage)...much to the dismay of her valley girlfriends who find Julie's punk hunk to be "grody to the max!" Fer Shure.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.

programme.title: The Winning Season
programme.desc: A misfit guy (Sam Rockwell) is brought on to coach the local girls' high school basketball team, but he never imagined how this experience would alter his life and theirs.

programme.title: Cutting Class
programme.desc: Troubled Brian Woods, back from a mental institution and dealing with his father's death, competes for Paula's love against rebel Dwight. As students vanish, suspicion falls on Brian, but the threat lurks elsewhere.

programme.title: North Hollywood
programme.desc: A kid must decide between choosing the future his father wants and following his dream of becoming a pro skater.

programme.title: Saved!
programme.desc: Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

programme.title: Igby Goes Down
programme.desc: Igby Slocumb, a rebellious and sarcastic seventeen-year-old boy, is at war with the stifling world of "old money" privilege he was born into. Igby figures there must be a better life out there -- and sets about finding it.
